#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for f in *.txt; do
  echo "file: $f ${f%.txt} $(wc -l < "$f")" | grep -v '^#' >> out.log 2>&1
done
if [[ -n "$HOME" && $# -gt 0 ]]; then export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH"; fi
cat <<EOF
heredoc $USER
EOF
ls -la /tmp && cd - || exit 1
